# Recorded by bbb-conform record. Review it with bbb-conform review before committing.
case create.body.forms
target fake

== step 1: call create (POST)
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/meetingID "${uid}"
/response/internalMeetingID "<sha1(meetingID)>-<time>"
/response/attendeePW "<random>"
/response/moderatorPW "<random>"
/response/createTime "<time>"
/response/messageKey
/response/message

== step 2: call create (POST)
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/meetingID "${uid}"
/response/internalMeetingID "<sha1(meetingID)>-<time>"
/response/attendeePW "<random>"
/response/moderatorPW "<random>"
/response/createTime "<time>"
/response/messageKey "duplicateWarning"
/response/message "This conference was already in existence and may currently be in progress."

== step 3: call create (POST)
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/meetingID "${uid}"
/response/internalMeetingID "<sha1(meetingID)>-<time>"
/response/attendeePW "<random>"
/response/moderatorPW "<random>"
/response/createTime "<time>"
/response/messageKey "duplicateWarning"
/response/message "This conference was already in existence and may currently be in progress."

== step 4: call create (POST)
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "FAILED"
/response/messageKey "unsupportedContentType"
/response/message "POST request Content-Type is missing or unsupported"

== step 5: call insertDocument (POST)
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/messageKey
/response/message "Presentation is being uploaded"

== step 6: call putRecordingTextTrack (POST)
status 200
header Content-Type application/json
body json
$.response.message "Text track uploaded successfully"
$.response.messageKey "upload_text_track_success"
$.response.returncode "SUCCESS"
